questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

102, 110, 126, 150, 182, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

102 + 8 = 110

110 + 16 = 126

126 + 24 = 150

150 + 32 = 182

**182 + 40 = 222**

Hence, “222” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If T + Q × P – U ÷ R ÷ S + V, the how is R related to Q?
questions.solution:
T + Q × P – U ÷ R ÷ S + V

By decoding given expression,

T is wife of Q, Q is son of P, P is husband of U, U is mother of R, R is mother of S, S is wife of V.

Hence, R is sister of Q.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

18 + 24 – 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 39
questions.solution:
**By interchanging ÷ and –**

**18 + 24 ÷ 6 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 4 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 24 - 3 = 39**

By interchanging × and +

18 × 24 - 6 + 6 ÷ 3 = 18 × 24 - 6 + 2 = 432 - 6 + 2 = 428 ≠ 39

By interchanging + and –

18 - 24 + 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 18 - 24 + 6 × 2 = 18 - 24 + 12 = 0≠39

By interchanging ÷ and +

18 div 24 - 6 times 6 + 3 = (3)/(4) - 36 + 3 = (3)/(4) - 33 ne 39

Hence, by interchanging “÷ and -” we get correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

3: 30 : : 4 : ?
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is,

3 : 30 → 3³ + 3 = 27 + 3 = 30

Similarly,

4³ + 4 = 64 + 4 = 68

Hence, 68 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different position of the same dice are shown. Which symbol will be on the face opposite to the one having "*" ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c792b9362c7a3784bb18aaa8ecaafc42a2223fd4aeb01ef95c5ab99750ebd733.png]
questions.solution:
If we look at 2ⁿd and 3rd cube, + is common in both.

In 2ⁿd cube → “= and @” are adjacent to +.

In 3rd cube → “! And $” are adjacent to +.

Only “*” face is remaining which is not adjacent to +.

Hence, “+” will be on the face opposite to “*”.

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Vinayak his father is 50 years. 5 years from now, Vinayak’s age will be one - fifth of his father’s age. What is Vinayak’s current age?
questions.solution:
Vinayak’s father’s age = X

Vinayak’s age = Y

Sum of theirs ages is 50.

So,

X + Y = 5

By taking second condition,

( {X + 5} ) times (1)/(5) = ( {Y + 5} )

X + 5 = 5Y + 25

X = 5Y + 20

Putting the value of X,

5Y + 20 + Y = 50

6Y = 30

Y = 5

Hence, Vinayak’s current age is 5 years.

questions.question:
Two statement are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All owls are parrots.

Some parrots are crows.

**Conclusions:**

I. No owl is a crow.

II. All parrots are owls.

III. Some owls are crows.

options.text: Either conclusion I or III Follows
Only conclusion II and III follows.
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef30eab6a0127a8b5444a9f927014a17b7006ee8a7d047b5d538cb257fd7a9d.png] 

I. No owl is a crow → False (Possible but not definite)

II. All parrots are owls → False (Possible but not definite)

III. Some owls are crows → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion I and III both are false and complimentary.

Hence, either conclusion I or III Follows.

questions.question: Three of the following four number - pairs are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number - pair that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

4 : 65 → 4³ + 1 = 64 + 1 = 65

1 : 2 → 1³ + 1 = 1 + 1 = 2

3 : 27 → 3³ + 1 = 27 + 1 = 28 ≠ 27

2 : 9 → 2³ + 1 = 8 + 1 = 9

Hence, “3 : 27” is different from the rest.
